noncomputable def x2611_14160_cutWeight {V Γ : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [AddCommMonoid Γ] (G : SimpleGraph V) (w : Sym2 V → Γ) (A : Finset V) : Γ := by
  classical
  exact ∑ u ∈ A, ∑ v ∈ Finset.univ \ A,
    if G.Adj u v then w (Sym2.mk u v) else 0
